candidates.description: This vector activates punctuation marks, symbols, and non-Latin character fragments acting as syntactic noise or sub-word artifacts.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to characters and subwords from Indic scripts, particularly Devanagari.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and common Hindi text subwords.
This vector represents characters, subwords, and abbreviations commonly used in Hindi script and transliterated Hindi text processing.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Hindi consonant 'भ' (bha) and its various conjunct forms combined with vowel matras and surrounding characters.
This feature activates for rare subword tokens across various non-English scripts and specialized terms.
This vector represents a noisy collection of multilingual alphanumeric characters and punctuation marks without a cohesive semantic theme.
This vector activates for common Hindi suffixes and postpositions, particularly oblique case markers and verb endings involving the vowel 'ा' (aa).
These tokens represent Hindi vowel sign diacritics combined with punctuation marks.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi character n-grams and vowel combinations.
